answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing secures the wharf where agents dock to transact. Graph clusters act like a dense nebula of interconnected trusts; whenever a topological cut verification detects forged clusters, auditing rings push dishonest nodes off the financial ledge. Falsifying identities and passing cross-audits forces exponential capital lockup and stake slashing, imposing superlinear attacker cost.
